feeds.title: Life In Arpeggio Blog
feeds.description: Life In Arpeggio is a platform for music journalism in Singapore; a digital vehicle to propel stories from the local scene and beyond into the spotlight. This medium traverses in-depth profile features, music-centric happenings in the city, explorations of trendy spots, and other news that sing the same tune.

feeds.title: Singapore 60s Music Blog
feeds.description: 60s to 70s music blog on western pops and its influence on Singapore. Video clips, photographs to enhance the tales told. This blog serves as a coffee-stop and written to relive my missing music years, keep seniors posted about our local music, encourage music stories from readers, keep our younger generation, especially my 3J's, aware of our music heritage and help students with term papers or information regarding popular culture and local music history in the 60's.
